title: The Telangana Improved Seeds and Seedlings Act, 1951.
full_text: The Telangana Improved Seeds and Seedlings Act, 1951. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 195128 Act Number: 28 Enactment Date: 1951-10-05 Act Year: 1951 Short Title: The Telangana Improved Seeds and Seedlings Act, 1951. Long Title: An Act to provide for the use of pure and certified seeds and seedlings of the improved varieties of crops recommended by the Department of Agriculture in Hyderabad. Department: Department of Agriculture and Cooperation Type: STATE Location: Telangana TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles Show all section Section 1. Short title, extent and date of commencement. Section 2. Definitions. Section 3. Power to declare seeds or seedlings of approved varieties of crops and to specify the area and period, and restrict movement. Section 4. Provision of seeds and seedlings by Agricultural Department. Section 5. Powers of the officers of the Agricultural Department to enter upon any land or premises. Section 6. Penalties. Section 7. Bar of suit or other legal proceedings. Section 8. Power of Government to make rules.
